Ashutosh Sharma.fit: Solves RR's historic finishing dilemma; hits elite 145+ kph pace at a 185.9 strike rate at the death without accumulating dot balls.
Ashutosh Sharma.strengths: Peerless bat speed, calm bat flow under 12+ RRR, clears straight boundaries.
Ashutosh Sharma.weaknesses: Can occasionally edge early balls against turning wrist spin.

Naman Dhir.fit: Counters powerplay collapses; 360-degree boundary scoring (185.5 SR, 38.5 Avg) against high pace and finger spin.
Naman Dhir.strengths: Fearless counter-puncher, innovative scoop and ramp shots under pressure.
Naman Dhir.weaknesses: Needs brief 3-4 ball sighter on tacky subcontinental tracks.

Jason Holder.fit: Provides towering lower-order boundary power (169.8 SR, +54.7 delta) and elite multi-skill balance in tight chases.
Jason Holder.strengths: Long reach counteracts wide yorkers; exceptional veteran temperament.
Jason Holder.weaknesses: Vulnerable to high-velocity short-pitched bodyline bowling.

Shashank Singh.fit: Brings pristine match awareness to steep chases; 170.4 SR with a low 24.6% dot ball percentage.
Shashank Singh.strengths: Dominant straight-bat placement, ice-cool demeanor in last-over chases.
Shashank Singh.weaknesses: Moderately reliant on pace on the ball.

Andre Russell.fit: Supreme raw power generating +129.3 Runs Above Expected and +1.343 WPA; strikes sheer psychological fear into opposition death bowlers.
Andre Russell.strengths: Highest boundary percentage (27.1%) in tournament history under pressure.
Andre Russell.weaknesses: High dot ball rate (42.4%) when searching exclusively for maximums.

Rashid Khan.fit: Transforms seemingly lost chases with rapid 10-ball 25-run bursts using his trademark snake shot.
Rashid Khan.strengths: Unorthodox wrist speed against yorkers and full tosses.

Mahendra Singh Dhoni.fit: Demonstrates +63.7 SR delta in high pressure (172.2 SR); unmatched target calculation and tactical acumen.
Mahendra Singh Dhoni.strengths: Legendary composure, targets the opponent's fifth bowler with mathematical certainty.
Mahendra Singh Dhoni.weaknesses: Reduced agility in running hard twos.

Rajat Patidar.fit: Elite spin demolisher averaging 41.75 at a 169.8 SR under collapse pressure; shields Sanju Samson from spin choke.
Rajat Patidar.strengths: Picks spin lengths instantly; huge sixes over mid-wicket against turn.
Rajat Patidar.weaknesses: Can be troubled by 145+ kph express pace on hard lengths.

Shadab Khan.fit: Bridges early collapses to death acceleration with high strike-rotation and a 170.3 pressure SR.
Shadab Khan.strengths: Excellent running between wickets and rapid boundary placement.

Rahul Tewatia.fit: Proven hero in RR colors; delivers 177.4 SR (+60.7 delta) and +1.437 WPA when requiring 12+ runs in the final over.
Rahul Tewatia.strengths: Unfazed by extreme chase math; elite leg-side sweeps and scoops.
Rahul Tewatia.weaknesses: Prefers bowling pace; quieter against high-quality wide yorker specialists.

Jasprit Bumrah.fit: The undisputed benchmark of global cricket; bowls overs 17 and 19 to shut down chases with a 6.89 economy and 15.3 SR.
Jasprit Bumrah.strengths: Pinpoint yorkers, disguised slower balls, unplayable angles.

Craig Young.fit: Seam presentation yielding a lethal 11.9 strike rate and 7.51 economy in high pressure (+1.35 tighter delta).
Craig Young.strengths: Aggressive skiddy bounce inducing false strokes from aggressive openers.

Varun Chakravarthy.fit: Concedes only 6.37 economy (+1.82 delta) with 33 wickets and 46% dot balls; gives RR an impenetrable middle-phase clamp.
Varun Chakravarthy.strengths: High release point and rapid mystery spin variations.
Varun Chakravarthy.weaknesses: Heavy dew slightly affects grip on leg-cutter.

Sunil Narine.fit: Total boundary denial (only 9.9% boundaries allowed) and a 6.02 economy under pressure; forces batters to attack partner bowlers.
Sunil Narine.weaknesses: Slightly lower wicket strike rate than Chakravarthy.

Ravindra Jadeja.fit: Delivers overs in under 2 minutes with a 6.03 economy (+1.98 delta) and 7.9% boundary rate; chokes left-right balance.
Ravindra Jadeja.strengths: Darting stump-to-stump trajectories giving zero extension.
Ravindra Jadeja.weaknesses: Less effective on flat tracks with zero grip.

Mohsin Khan.fit: Provides the steep left-arm angle RR values alongside Boult; executes yorkers and off-cutters under pressure (7.89 economy).
Mohsin Khan.strengths: High release angle and natural angle across right-handers.

Akeal Hosein.fit: Master of pace modulation conceding only 6.33 economy and 10.2% boundaries; locks down early powerplays.
Akeal Hosein.weaknesses: Less threatening against set death batters.

Abrar Ahmed.fit: Takes 14 wickets at 14.86 SR and 6.32 economy under pressure; breaks stubborn partnerships before the death overs.
Abrar Ahmed.strengths: Devastating googly and carrom ball deception.
Abrar Ahmed.weaknesses: Occasional loose boundary ball when over-flighting.

Benjamin Sears.fit: Generates 148+ kph skid rattling lower-order batters with a 7.05 economy and 14.8 SR (+1.29 delta).
Benjamin Sears.strengths: Raw express pace that rushes pull shots.
Benjamin Sears.weaknesses: Higher boundary conceded % (16.2%) if yorker length is missed.

Mustafizur Rahman.fit: Highest pressure sample in dataset (616 balls, 42 wickets, 7.51 economy, +186.0 EAE); past RR star tailor-made for slow Jaipur wickets.
Mustafizur Rahman.strengths: World's most deceptive off-cutter and cross-seam bouncers.
Mustafizur Rahman.weaknesses: More predictable on true, high-bouncing surfaces.
